name: FB0
note: Channel 0 feedback: connect to OUT0 in voltage-output mode, leave open in current-output mode

name: GPIO
note: General-purpose I/O: LDAC, power-down, protect, reset, status

name: SCL
note: I2C serial clock (SPI chip select in SPI mode)

name: A0
note: I2C address: connect to VDD, AGND, SDA or SCL

name: SDA
note: I2C serial data (SPI clock in SPI mode)

name: FB1
note: Channel 1 feedback: connect to OUT1 in voltage-output mode, leave open in current-output mode

name: AGND
note: Ground (the thermal pad connects to it)

name: VREF
note: External reference input: pull up to VDD when the internal reference is used
